title: CRDs are too large for client-side apply — use server-side apply

detection.reason: a CRD carrying kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration was last written by client-side apply (kubectl apply, or Argo CD without ServerSideApply); Helm-installed CRDs carry none

quote: Please note that this a breaking change because our CRDs are now too big. Meaning a simple kubectl apply or Argo's default client side apply WILL NOT WORK!
remediation: Install the 0.19+ CRDs with `kubectl apply --server-side` (or Helm), and add `ServerSideApply=true` to the `syncOptions` of the Argo CD Application that manages them; the client-side annotation exceeds the 262144-byte limit.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | endswith("external-secrets.io")) | select(.metadata.annotations["kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration"] != null) | .metadata.name'  # each name was last applied client-side

title: STSSessionToken generator: JWT authentication removed
quote: fix: remove authentication option with JWT token from STSSessionToken generator
remediation: Switch each STSSessionToken generator that uses `auth.jwt` to `auth.secretRef` (static credentials); AWS GetSessionToken cannot be called with web-identity credentials and 0.19 rejects the combination.
verifyCommand: kubectl get stssessiontokens.generators.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.auth.jwt != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row uses the removed JWT auth

title: cert-controller reads EndpointSlices — non-Helm installs need the new RBAC
quote: feat: migration from endpoint to endpointslice
remediation: Helm adds the rule. For a non-Helm install, grant the cert-controller's ServiceAccount `get`, `list`, `watch` on `endpointslices` in `discovery.k8s.io` before upgrading; without it the webhook readiness check never passes.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterrole -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("external-secrets-cert-controller")) | "\(.metadata.name) endpointslices=\([.rules[] | select((.resources // []) | index("endpointslices"))] | length)"'  # 0 means the cert-controller cannot read EndpointSlices
